question: Does the unchanged Stage 5 prediction-assisted uniform evaluator save queries on the WMT23 pools where Stage 6 extra-label acquisition failed?
status: follow-up diagnostic on data already inspected in Stage 6; no untouched validation claim
holdout: leave one system out before building all historical features or transformations
data: Unchanged Stage 6 WMT23 derived binary recorded-human pools: en-de, he-en, zh-en
querying: uniform without replacement for every Stage 5 method, exactly matched to the Stage 6 raw stream
engine: Stage 5 statistical modules copied byte for byte; no hyperparameter, weight, grid, threshold, stake, gate or predictor-rule change
historical_fit: SVD/ridge rules are unchanged, but features are recomputed within each target-excluded WMT23 bank; no trained WMT24 model is transferred
prediction_fit: frozen-rule online updates use only previously queried target labels; current outcomes cannot affect their own predictions or stakes
primary_measure: unique target segment scores needed for first nonempty interval of width at most 0.10
primary_summary: equal weight to languages, then target systems within language, then paired query repeats
secondary_measures: simultaneous full-path coverage, saved midpoint error, empty intervals, empty-mixture repairs, fixed prior confidence levels and per-target/per-path costs
cost_bound_scope: reserve_mix75 is bounded by raw PPR at 96.25% confidence, not ordinary raw95; Stage 6's 10% paid-query cap does not transfer to it
interpretation: A difference from Stage 6 is a pipeline comparison: predictor and statistical treatment both differ, so it cannot isolate a causal contribution from either one alone
selection_rule: Do not retune, replace primary with a favorable reserve weight, change pools, or claim ICML novelty from this diagnostic
